hold_text: Adds a DELETE mode (dry_run default true) to cancel-queued-runs.yml for never-started zombie runs. Destructive capability, so held for the manager merge. The live delete additionally needs the operator decision on record.
why: ACTIONS-ZOMBIE-QUEUED-RUNS: cancel and force-cancel both return HTTP 409 for these runs; DELETE is the only API path left. CI workflow only; no runtime, config or order path.
